model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the level of preparedness and qualification of professionals for implementing projects according to the "Passive House" standard. It is divided into four segments, each representing a different category of expertise and training needs. The largest segment, colored green and accounting for 51% of the chart, corresponds to the category "Only a small part of the executors/designers are prepared to implement projects according to the Passive House standard, and a large number of specialists need training for implementation of the standard." The second and third segments, both at 23%, are colored red and purple, respectively. The red segment represents "Only part of the executors/designers are prepared to implement projects according to the Passive House standard," while the purple segment indicates "There are not enough prepared and qualified specialists for building houses according to the Passive House standard." The smallest segment, at 3% and colored blue, corresponds to "Well-prepared and well-qualified to implement projects according to the Passive House standard." The chart includes a legend on the right side, clearly associating each color with its respective category, and percentage values are displayed directly within each slice. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, starting from the top-right, with the largest segment (green) occupying the bottom half of the chart.
